correctness.rationale: PASS. The common refinement has A_j of length t and B_j of length 1-t and Q_t shifted membership. The exact kernel norm on ambient L¹ equals the maximum weighted column sum of the 2n-cell matrix because normalized individual cell indicators realize each column. Evaluating the two input atom types gives 2(1-t)(t+|2t-1|) and 2t((1-t)+|2t-1|) when n≥3, whose maximum is 2max(t,1-t)^2; at n=2 the periodic target collisions subtract and give 2max(t,1-t)|2t-1|. K*=−K gives identical L∞ norm. Circulant cross Gram matrix (1-t)I+tS yields principal cosines and the claimed nonzero L² singular values, then interpolation gives norm convergence to zero at 1<p<∞ while endpoint norms tend to 2 as t approaches 0 or 1.
residual_risks: Singular spectrum statement excludes zero singular values and accounts for multiplicities; duplicate Fourier frequencies do not generate additional singular modes.
At t=0 or t=1 exact commutator is zero; the endpoint result is one-sided interior limit and deliberately discontinuous.
